scope: Synthetic RC4 and AES vectors plus one Windows 10 19041 x64 crash dump. Not an account-level hash acceptance: the selected image has no resident JD class cell.

comparison.scope: selected fields only; full capability acceptance remains pending

notes: The pinned windows.registry.hashdump.Hashdump reference emits no rows and warns that the hboot key is not valid. The JD class cell 0x231ce0 is a nonpresent page at 0xffffc2041fb0ace0 in both the kernel and the Registry process.
Native output fails the task, keeps that read error, and emits no hash row. An empty hash list is not reported as success.

The go test binary that rechecked the image is bfad9d35ec40103d5a9856ad224b3758115a68b19f9f34eca2ff5b1431bbfb5f. The compared JSONL was written by bin/gomem 811a828d7a01d0e09d301edc519a8b1292145665ab1c9c726b1a98fe19e733ea.
Synthetic RC4 revision-2 and AES revision-3 vectors, including the NT salt at nt_offset+8, match the pinned algorithm. That is not a substitute for a resident account differential.
